segments.text: Now let's see what are the hazards of electricity and what are its protective measures.

segments.text: The full form of ELCB is Earth-Liquid Circuit Breaker.
segments.zh: ELCB 的全称是 Earth Leakage Circuit Breaker，即漏电断路器。

segments.text: And the full form of RCCB is Residual Current Circuit Breaker.
segments.zh: RCCB 的全称是 Residual Current Circuit Breaker，即剩余电流动作断路器。

segments.text: RCCB is the updated version of ELCB.
segments.zh: RCCB 是 ELCB 的升级版本，

segments.text: And these days it has been completely replaced by RCCB.
segments.zh: 现在它已经完全被 RCCB 取代了。

segments.text: So let's know what ELCB means first.
segments.zh: 那我们先来了解 ELCB 是什么意思。

segments.text: ELCB means Earth-Liquid Circuit Breaker.
segments.zh: ELCB 就是漏电断路器。

segments.text: Now let's see how it works.
segments.zh: 现在我们来看看它是怎样工作的。

segments.text: The green wire that we connect in ELCB is called Earth.
segments.zh: 我们在 ELCB 里接的绿线叫做地线，

segments.text: And its earth terminal is connected through a sensitive block.
segments.zh: 它的接地端子是通过一个灵敏模块连接的。

segments.text: So what happens in ELCB is that incoming power comes.
segments.zh: ELCB 里是这样的：进线电源进来，

segments.text: A red and a black.
segments.zh: 一根红线和一根黑线，

segments.text: That means you can call it face or neutral.
segments.zh: 也就是你可以叫它相线或零线，

segments.text: And its outgoing power is red and black.
segments.zh: 而它的出线电源是红线和黑线，

segments.text: That means phase or neutral.
segments.zh: 也就是相线或零线。

segments.text: That means phase or neutral is incoming power and its outgoing power is also there.
segments.zh: 也就是说，相线或零线是进线电源，它也有出线电源。

segments.text: That incoming power and outgoing power are connected through a sensitive tripping block.
segments.zh: 进线电源和出线电源通过一个灵敏脱扣模块连接，

segments.text: And that sensitive tripping block is connected through the earthing wire.
segments.zh: 而这个灵敏脱扣模块通过接地线连接。

segments.text: If the outgoing red color wire is accidentally contacted by the green color wire.
segments.zh: 如果出线的红色电线意外地碰到了绿色电线，

segments.text: Then the red wire of the face and the green ground wire.
segments.zh: 那么相线的红线和绿色的接地线，

segments.text: The current flowing in it will get leakage.
segments.zh: 其中流过的电流就会发生泄漏，

segments.text: Because of which the tripping coil starts to get voltage drop.
segments.zh: 因此脱扣线圈上开始产生电压降。

segments.text: This voltage drop is enough to activate the trip circuit.
segments.zh: 这个电压降足以启动脱扣电路，

segments.text: That means that voltage drop will activate the trip circuit.
segments.zh: 也就是说这个电压降会启动脱扣电路，

segments.text: And finally the ELCB will be open.
segments.zh: 最后 ELCB 就会断开，

segments.text: That means it will be isolated from its source.
segments.zh: 也就是会与它的电源隔离开，

segments.text: That means it will isolate the source from that file.
segments.zh: 也就是会把电源与那个故障隔离开。

segments.text: Now let's understand how the function of RCCB is.
segments.zh: 现在我们来了解 RCCB 的功能是怎样的。

segments.text: RCCB means residual current circuit breaker.
segments.zh: RCCB 就是剩余电流动作断路器。

segments.text: RCCB works under the principle of core balance current transformer.
segments.zh: RCCB 是按照零序电流互感器的原理工作的。

segments.text: So the main function of RCCB is monitoring.
segments.zh: 所以 RCCB 的主要功能是监测。

segments.text: What it does is that the phase wire and the neutral wire.
segments.zh: 它做的是，相线和零线，

segments.text: It monitors how much current is flowing in it.
segments.zh: 它监测其中流过多少电流。

segments.text: Especially the load is connected across the phase and neutral terminals.
segments.zh: 特别是负载接在相线和零线端子之间。

segments.text: That means in RCCB the core balance current transformer.
segments.zh: 也就是说，在 RCCB 中，零序电流互感器

segments.text: It monitors how much current is flowing in the phase and neutral.
segments.zh: 监测相线和零线中流过多少电流，

segments.text: That means how much current is flowing in the phase wire.
segments.zh: 也就是相线中流过多少电流，

segments.text: And how much current is coming back from the neutral wire.
segments.zh: 以及从零线中流回多少电流。

segments.text: That means if the current is flowing in the phase wire.
segments.zh: 也就是说，如果相线中有电流流过，

segments.text: Then obviously the same current is coming back from the neutral wire.
segments.zh: 那么显然零线中也会流回同样的电流，

segments.text: That means the current flow of these two will be the same.
segments.zh: 也就是这两者的电流是相同的，

segments.text: It will be zero in its core balance current transformer.
segments.zh: 在零序电流互感器中合成为零。

segments.text: At that time RCCB will not operate in that normal condition.
segments.zh: 在这种正常情况下，RCCB 不会动作。

segments.text: Let's consider that if someone falls.
segments.zh: 我们假设，如果有人摔倒，

segments.text: Or if a person touches the live phase wire.
segments.zh: 或者有人碰到了带电的相线，

segments.text: Because of which the live wire and earth.
segments.zh: 因此带电的线和大地，

segments.text: The current flow between these two will get leakage.
segments.zh: 这两者之间的电流就会发生泄漏。

segments.text: That means the existing load of the phase was 20 mA.
segments.zh: 也就是说，相线现有的负载是 20 mA，

segments.text: Now when a person touches the phase.
segments.zh: 现在当有人碰到相线时，

segments.text: The current flow from that is leakage.
segments.zh: 由此就会发生电流泄漏，

segments.text: That means the fault current and leakage current will get increased.
segments.zh: 也就是故障电流和泄漏电流会增加，

segments.text: That means now it will be 30 mA.
segments.zh: 也就是现在会变成 30 mA，

segments.text: But our neutral wire was carrying 20 mA.
segments.zh: 但我们的零线载的是 20 mA。

segments.text: Now when this load has increased.
segments.zh: 现在当这个负载增加了，

segments.text: That means 10 mA load has increased.
segments.zh: 也就是增加了 10 mA 的负载，

segments.text: Now the leakage current will go from another pass.
segments.zh: 现在泄漏电流就会走另一条路径，

segments.text: That means the path of earth will go from that pass.
segments.zh: 也就是从大地那条路径走。

segments.text: So the difference is that the previous 20 mA load.
segments.zh: 所以差值就是，原来 20 mA 的负载

segments.text: Now it has become 30 mA.
segments.zh: 现在变成了 30 mA，

segments.text: So this load will detect the RCCB.
segments.zh: 这个负载就会被 RCCB 检测到，

segments.text: That means it will sense through CBCT.
segments.zh: 也就是它会通过 CBCT 感知到，

segments.text: That means through the core balance current transformer.
segments.zh: 也就是通过零序电流互感器。

segments.text: So now the CBCT has sensed the current leakage.
segments.zh: 所以现在 CBCT 感知到了电流泄漏，

segments.text: So now it will send the unbalanced current to relay operating coils.
segments.zh: 现在它就会把不平衡电流送到继电器动作线圈，

segments.text: And when it will reach the relay operating coils.
segments.zh: 当它到达继电器动作线圈时，

segments.text: Then finally the RCCB will get tripped.
segments.zh: 最后 RCCB 就会跳闸，

segments.text: That means the fault current will get isolated.
segments.zh: 也就是故障电流会被隔离。

segments.text: So now you will know what are the functions of ELCB and RCCB.
segments.zh: 所以现在你们就知道了 ELCB 和 RCCB 有哪些功能，

segments.text: And how it functions.
segments.zh: 以及它们是怎样工作的。

segments.text: So now let's see the difference between the two.
segments.zh: 那现在我们来看看这两者的区别。

segments.text: So the full form of ELCB is Earth leakage circuit breaker.
segments.zh: ELCB 的全称是漏电断路器，

segments.text: And the full form of RCCB is residual current circuit breaker.
segments.zh: RCCB 的全称是剩余电流动作断路器。

segments.text: And the second name of RCCB is RCB.
segments.zh: RCCB 的另一个名称是 RCD，

segments.text: It is also called as residual current device.
segments.zh: 它也被称为剩余电流保护装置。

segments.text: So ELCB is voltage operated.
segments.zh: ELCB 是电压动作型的，

segments.text: And RCCB is current operated.
segments.zh: 而 RCCB 是电流动作型的。

segments.text: So ELCB can also say that voltage operated is Earth leakage circuit breaker.
segments.zh: 所以 ELCB 也可以说是电压动作型漏电断路器，

segments.text: And RCCB can also say that current operated is residual current circuit breaker.
segments.zh: 而 RCCB 也可以说是电流动作型剩余电流动作断路器，

segments.text: Or current operated is residual current device.
segments.zh: 或者电流动作型剩余电流保护装置。

segments.text: The earth connection in ELCB should be in good condition.
segments.zh: ELCB 的接地连接应该状况良好，

segments.text: Only then the ELCB will function well.
segments.zh: 只有这样 ELCB 才能正常工作。

segments.text: And if the good earth connection is not in RCCB.
segments.zh: 而 RCCB 如果没有良好的接地连接，

segments.text: Only then it will function well.
segments.zh: 也照样能正常工作，

segments.text: That means it will work well.
segments.zh: 也就是说它能正常工作。

segments.text: What happens in ELCB is that the leakage current or the fault current.
segments.zh: ELCB 是这样的：泄漏电流或故障电流

segments.text: It should flow from its earth pass.
segments.zh: 应该从它的接地路径流过，

segments.text: If it does not flow from earth pass.
segments.zh: 如果不从接地路径流过，

segments.text: Then it will not work.
segments.zh: 它就不会起作用，

segments.text: It will not operate.
segments.zh: 它就不会动作。

segments.text: And what happens in RCCB is that the current leakage.
segments.zh: 而 RCCB 是这样的：电流泄漏

segments.text: It flows from earth pass.
segments.zh: 从接地路径流过时，

segments.text: Then it will trip.
segments.zh: 它就会跳闸，

segments.text: Otherwise it will not operate.
segments.zh: 否则它就不会动作。

segments.text: So the first ELCB that used to come.
segments.zh: 所以最早出现的 ELCB

segments.text: It was called voltage operated earth leakage circuit breaker.
segments.zh: 被称为电压动作型漏电断路器，

segments.text: And now the RCCB that comes.
segments.zh: 而现在出现的 RCCB

segments.text: It is called current operated residual current circuit breaker.
segments.zh: 被称为电流动作型剩余电流动作断路器。

segments.text: So the main difference in this is that you have to understand.
segments.zh: 所以这里面的主要区别你要明白：

segments.text: That the first ELCB that used to come.
segments.zh: 最早出现的 ELCB

segments.text: It was called voltage operated ELCB.
segments.zh: 被称为电压动作型 ELCB，

segments.text: And now the ELCB that comes.
segments.zh: 而现在出现的 ELCB

segments.text: It is called current operated ELCB.
segments.zh: 被称为电流动作型 ELCB，

segments.text: Now we call it RCCB and RCCDB.
segments.zh: 现在我们称它为 RCCB 和 RCCDB，

segments.text: Because their function is semi.
segments.zh: 因为它们的功能是一样的。
